name: jev-compaction-plus
description: Claude Code compaction in half a second: Jev keeps what's still needed word for word, and moves the rest to a drawer file instead of deleting it.

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: A TypeSafe key, or an OpenRouter key (sk-or-...). Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Only used when drawerDir is empty: characters of a dropped tool result kept in place, plus a note.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Jev model name. With an OpenRouter key, jev-latest is sent as typesafe/jev-1.13.

baseUrl.title: Jev endpoint
baseUrl.description: Optional. Unset: TypeSafe's API, or OpenRouter's decisions API when the key starts with sk-or-.

previewChars.title: Preview characters
previewChars.description: Characters of each tool result (start and end) Jev sees when deciding whether to keep it.

minDropChars.title: Always keep below
minDropChars.description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are always kept: dropping them saves almost nothing.

drawerDir.title: Drawer folder
drawerDir.description: Folder where dropped results are saved, so Claude can read them back. ~/ is the home folder; a relative path is resolved against the project. Empty: delete them like fast-jev-compaction does.
